messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, raises one arm to touch her head, then turns to face the camera while holding a small object near her mouth.","camera":"A static, slightly high-angle medium shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting romper with a multicolored geometric pattern in pink, purple, yellow, blue, and black, plus red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small ponytail or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from behind and then in profile.","scene":"An outdoor tiled plaza with reflective metal panels on the left, a textured gray ground area on the right, and white structures in the background under warm, low-angle sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background and ground changed from a sandy area to a tiled plaza with reflective metal panels on the left, textured gray ground on the right, and white structures in the background, matching the reference. The character, blue hair, multicolored romper, red shoes, pose sequence, and camera framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original sandy outdoor scene with the reference environment while preserving the same character, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was fully preserved, since the face is not clearly visible in most frames.
unexpected_changes: The character's shadow direction and appearance changed to match the new scene lighting.
